title: Source: the White House imposed export controls on Mythos partly over suspicions a China-linked group had accessed it (Reed Albergotti/Semafor)
summary: Reed Albergotti / Semafor: Source: the White House imposed export controls on Mythos partly over suspicions a China-linked group had accessed it — THE SCOOP — The White House imposed export controls on Anthropic's powerful Mythos AI model partly over suspicions that a China-linked group had accessed it, a person familiar with the matter said.
